content.title: Open the profile popover and review identity details
content.intent: Prove that activating the avatar opens the profile popover and shows the signed-in user's name, role, workspace, status, and the full action list.
content.technique_notes: Applied auth to the signed-in profile surface. Strength=3 because auth risk applies. No equivalence-class, boundary-value, or covering-array expansion was needed because the source fixed one display state and named no variable inputs or alternate outcomes.
